about_screen.title: About Layla
about_screen.subtitle: Navigate the world with Layla; AI trip planner and your ultimate travel sidekick.
about_screen.block_1: I'm Layla. I plan trips for a living, and I'm good at it. Tell me where you're leaning, who's coming and what kind of trip you actually want, and I'll have a real plan in front of you in minutes, not a mood board. I have opinions about where you should go. I'll share them.
about_screen.block_2: Here's how I work. I read what you tell me, pick up on what you don't, and shape the trip around it: the right city for the right week, a neighbourhood that fits how you live, the restaurant worth crossing town for. No endless scrolling, no forty open tabs. Think of me as the friend with ridiculously good taste who already did the research.
about_screen.block_3: I plan the whole thing, not just the highlights. Flights that connect sensibly, hotels I'd actually stay in, days paced so you're not sprinting between sights. If your plans change, tell me and I'll rework the itinerary around them. You stay in charge; I handle the logistics.
about_screen.block_4: Then real people take over. Behind me is a team of human travel advisors who book, confirm and handle the details. They check the things an AI shouldn't guess at, like whether that transfer is realistic or that “sea view” is real, and they're reachable when something goes sideways on the road. Planned by Layla. Handled by her advisors.
about_screen.block_5: Booking is straightforward. Once you're happy with the plan, we lock it in. Flights, stays and activities come from trusted partners, with hotels booked through Expedia, so prices are real and bookings are confirmed. No sketchy sites, no surprise fees.
about_screen.block_6: The trip doesn't end at check-in. While you're away I'm still here: the best coffee near your hotel, what to do when it rains, how to get across town without losing an afternoon. Ask any time. The advisors are on hand around the clock too, in whatever time zone you've landed in.
about_screen.block_7:
So if you're done with the same old guidebook itinerary and want a trip that's actually yours, start a conversation with me. I'll plan it with taste, and the advisors will make it real.

Adventure awaits ✈️

thailand.title: Thailand's Andaman coast
thailand.intro: Phi Phi by speedboat, sunset at Promthep Cape and a cooking class in Phuket, then jungle rafting and quiet beaches in Khao Lak.

japan.title: Japan's kitchens, temples and hot springs
japan.intro: Sushi with a Tsukiji chef, Zen meditation with a monk, a cooking class in Kanazawa, Nishiki Market and sake in Kyoto, then ramen in Osaka and Sapporo's seafood.

iceland_road_trip.title: Iceland's south coast by car
iceland_road_trip.intro: A rental car around the Golden Circle, black sand at Vik, the glacier lagoon near Skaftafell and the ancient caves of Hella, back to Reykjavik.

east_africa.title: East Africa in 24 days, Kilimanjaro to Zanzibar
east_africa.route: Kilimanjaro → Amboseli → Samburu → Maasai Mara → Nairobi → Zanzibar
east_africa.intro: Elephants under Kilimanjaro in Amboseli, the Samburu Special Five, flamingos at Lake Nakuru, five nights of game drives in the Maasai Mara, then Stone Town's alleys and the white sand of Zanzibar.

bali.title: Bali, temples to turquoise
bali.intro: Rice terraces and temples around Ubud, slow island days on Gili Trawangan, then a beach finish in Nusa Dua.

iceland.title: Iceland under the aurora
iceland.intro: A design hotel in Reykjavik, nights out chasing the northern lights, Perlan, a food walk and a soak at Sky Lagoon.

lapland.title: Lapland in the snow
lapland.route: Rovaniemi → Santa Claus Village → Arctic wilderness
lapland.intro: Santa Claus Village, a snowmobile ride out to ice fishing, a northern lights photo tour and a proper Finnish sauna.

madeira.title: Madeira by car
madeira.route: Funchal → Ponta de São Lourenço → Pico do Arieiro
madeira.intro: A clifftop five-star in Funchal and a car to explore: sunrise at Ponta de São Lourenço, whales offshore and the peaks of Pico do Arieiro.

egypt.title: Red Sea in El Gouna
egypt.intro: Lagoon views at a five-star resort, snorkeling the Red Sea reefs, a boat and tuk-tuk tour of El Gouna and slow days by the water.

thailand_north_to_south.title: Thailand, Bangkok to Phuket
thailand_north_to_south.intro: Canal boats, Muay Thai and a backstreet food tour in Bangkok, temples and a cooking class in Chiang Mai, then elephants and night markets in Phuket.

thailand_temples_and_sea.title: Thailand's temples, mountains and sea
thailand_temples_and_sea.route: Bangkok → Chiang Mai → Railay → Koh Lanta
thailand_temples_and_sea.intro: The Mandarin Oriental in Bangkok, Chiang Mai's old temples and an elephant sanctuary, kayaks and glowing plankton at Railay, then quiet days on Koh Lanta.

puglia.title: Puglia, coast to countryside
puglia.intro: A sunset cruise off Polignano, the trulli of Alberobello and olive oil in Valle d'Itria, baroque Lecce, then canoeing the sea caves of Santa Maria di Leuca.

australia.title: Australia in 19 days, Tasmania to the Reef
australia.route: Hobart → Melbourne → Uluru → Sydney → Cairns → Singapore
australia.intro: Wild Tasmania and Melbourne's laneways, sunrise over Uluru, Sydney Harbour and the Hunter Valley vineyards, then Tamborine's rainforest and the Great Barrier Reef, with a Singapore stopover.

japan_treasures.title: Japan's treasures: Osaka, Miyajima, Kyoto & Tokyo
japan_treasures.intro: Osaka's street food and neon, the floating torii of Miyajima, five slow days among Kyoto's temples and tea houses, then Tokyo from Senso-ji to Shibuya.
